# Partners in PROMISE

> > Partners in PROMISE advocates for exceptional military children's special education rights through resources, mentorship, and policy change.

Partners in PROMISE is a specialized advocacy organization dedicated to supporting military families navigating special education for children with disabilities. The organization provides free consultations, comprehensive toolkits, educational resources, and policy advocacy to ensure military children receive appropriate special education services under IDEA and Section 504.

## Key Topics

- EFMP (Exceptional Family Member Program)
- IEP (Individualized Education Program)
- IDEA (Individuals with Disabilities Education Act)
- Section 504 Plans
- Military families
- Special education advocacy
- PCS (Permanent Change of Station)
- FAPE (Free Appropriate Public Education)
- Parent mentorship
- Functional Behavior Assessments
- ADHD
- Autism
- ABA Therapy
- Disability rights
- Military relocation

## About Partners in PROMISE

- [Homepage](https://thepromiseact.org): Homepage for Partners in PROMISE, protecting military children's special education rights
- [What We Do](https://thepromiseact.org/what-we-do): Overview of Partners in PROMISE services, advocacy, and resources for EFMP families
- [Our PROMISE](https://thepromiseact.org/what-we-do/our-promise): Mission statement detailing organization's commitment to military special education advocacy
- [Our Advocacy](https://thepromiseact.org/what-we-do/our-advocacy): Advocacy initiatives and policy change efforts for exceptional military families
- [Our Data & Reports](https://thepromiseact.org/what-we-do/our-data): Research reports and survey data on military special education experiences and EFMP outcomes
- [PROMISE 2026](https://thepromiseact.org/promise-2026): Summary of PROMISE 2026 event highlighting award recipients and policy advocacy efforts

## Get Help & Support

- [Get Special Education Help](https://thepromiseact.org/get-help): Central hub for accessing special education help, IEP guidance, and PCS relocation support
- [Free Parent Mentor Consultations](https://thepromiseact.org/get-help/parent-mentor-consultations): Free consultation services connecting military families with parent mentors for special education advocacy
- [New Special Ed Parents](https://thepromiseact.org/get-help/new-special-ed-parents): Beginner's guide for newly diagnosed special education families covering IEP and 504 plans
- [Transitioning Parents](https://thepromiseact.org/get-help/transitioning-parents): Resources for military families transitioning schools with post-secondary planning guidance
- [For Students](https://thepromiseact.org/get-help/for-students): Student-focused resources including IEP navigation and post-secondary planning support

## Toolkits & Educational Resources

- [Our Toolkit](https://thepromiseact.org/what-we-do/our-tookit): Comprehensive toolkit with IEP resources, PCS transition guides, and parent advocacy materials
- [Free Special Education Binder](https://thepromiseact.org/resources/binder): Free downloadable binder template for organizing IEP documents and 504 plan information
- [Educational Workshops](https://thepromiseact.org/resources/workshops): Scheduled educational workshops on IEP training and special needs parent advocacy
- [Webinars & Video Library](https://thepromiseact.org/resources/webinars): Video library with webinars on IDEA, Section 504, and special education law topics
- [Mission PROMISE Podcast](https://thepromiseact.org/resources/podcasts): Mission PROMISE podcast series on special education navigation and EFMP support

## Resources & Reference

- [Resources](https://thepromiseact.org/resources): Comprehensive resource library with guides, workshops, podcasts, and EFMP information
- [Blog](https://thepromiseact.org/blog): Blog featuring articles on IEP advocacy, ADHD, dyslexia, military deployment, and FBA
- [DOW & EFMP Support](https://thepromiseact.org/resources/dow-efmp-support): Department of War and military branch EFMP enrollment forms and support resources
